name: Shipo
author: Shipo

sections.description:
[RO] Shipo este un plugin WooCommerce care îți conectează magazinul online cu mai mulți curieri de top, instant și fără contract. Cu un singur cont pe shipo.ro vei avea toate avantajele de mai jos:
Checkout configurabil: alegi dacă afișezi un singur curier sau mai mulți, livrare la adresă sau locker (cu hartă integrată) și îți setezi propriile tarife de livrare.
Economie de timp și bani: tarife accesibile și AWB-uri generate automat.
Servicii premium: plătești doar pentru coletele livrate.
Pentru mai multe detalii sau suport, ne găsești pe shipo.ro.

[EN] Shipo is a WooCommerce plugin that instantly connects your online store with top couriers, no contracts required. With a single account on shipo.ro, you’ll enjoy all the benefits below:
Configurable checkout: choose to display one courier or multiple, delivery to address or locker (with integrated map), and set your own shipping rates.
Save time and money: affordable rates and automatically generated AWBs.
Premium services: you only pay for parcels that are successfully delivered.
For more details or support, visit us at shipo.ro.
sections.changelog:
This plugin connects to an API to obtain the rates for shipments, it`s needed to can generate the orders with and usign our shipping services.
Allows customers to select shipping locations from API-populated lists and view real-time rates during checkout.
Features include API authentication, dynamic city/street selection, real-time shipping rates, configurable sender addresses, custom courier pricing, free shipping thresholds, and automatic AWB generation.
Requires WooCommerce to working.

1.0

First version of the plugin, it connects to the Shipo API to obtain shipping rates and allows customers to select shipping locations from API-populated lists and view real-time rates during checkout.

1.1

Fix city name selector from checkout page
Fix locker missing coordinates message
Fix locker data selector

1.2

Bug fix

1.3

Showing all lockers

1.4

Checkout page improvements:
– Allows users to manually enter a street name in the free text field if the street is not found in the suggestions dropdown list

1.5

  • Changes have been made to ensure this version can run properly on PHP 7.4+, providing compatibility and stable performance in PHP 7.4+ environments.

1.6

Fix checkout functions for PHP 7

1.7

New Features
– Added a new option for product weight override.

Improvements
– Added plugin translations to support multiple languages.

1.7.1

Improvements
– Fix sender locker

1.7.2

Improvements
– Enhanced AWB generation process for better reliability

1.7.3

Improvements
– Added support for Billing State and Shipping State fields in the checkout process. This ensures more accurate address collection, improves order validation, and enhances compatibility with region-specific shipping and tax calculations.

1.7.4

Improvements
– Improved city/state/street autofill with suggestions and debounce optimization
– Enhanced checkout UX and stability with multiple fixes and flow improvements

New
– Refactored checkout flow to support Block Components architecture
– Added support for saving checkout and city data for guests and logged-in users

1.7.5

Improvements
– Fixed county auto-selection in classic checkout so cities are matched to the correct county
– Improved city-to-county matching to prefer exact matches and avoid partial-name collisions

Compatibility
– Verified compatibility with WordPress 7+

1.7.6

Improvements
– Fixed the authentication for API

1.7.7

Improvements
– Product weight conversion to kilograms for API requests.
– Checkout postal code handling based on selected city and address.

1.7.8

Improvements
– Checkout address handling for Block Checkout.
– Product dimension conversion to centimetres for API requests.

Compatibility
– Verified compatibility with WooCommerce 10

1.7.9

Improvements
– General stability and compatibility improvements.
